sloka: भूषणानि च मुख्यानि तानि सेव मया सह ।पुष्पकम् नाम सुश्रोणि भ्रातुः वैश्रवणस्य मे ॥३-५५-२९॥
transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni ca mukhyāni tāni seva mayā saha ।puṣpakam nāma suśroṇi bhrātuḥ vaiśravaṇasya me ॥3-55-29॥

translations.english: O finehipped lady, I won by my strength from my brother Vaisravana (Kubera) an aerial chariot called Pushpaka shining with the radiance of the Sun.
